overview: This House resolution assigns several House members to standing committees, the permanent panels that write and review legislation in specific areas. It places Ms. Wasserman Schultz, Mr. Pocan and Mr. Bell on the Foreign Affairs Committee; Ms. Lee of Pennsylvania on the Judiciary Committee; Mr. Menefee on the Oversight and Government Reform Committee; Ms. Mejia on the Small Business Committee; and Ms. Goodlander on the Veterans' Affairs Committee. Resolutions like this are a routine way the House fills committee seats. The House adopted it on June 9, 2026.
for: Supporters say filling committee seats promptly lets members take part fully in drafting and overseeing legislation.
against: Critics say this is a routine internal step that changes no law and has no direct effect on the public.
